note: The project's recorded claim state, read by claim_guards.validate_recorded_claim. Before this file existed validate_claim read evidence from NOWHERE: nothing in production built a claim dict and E0's admissibility lived only as a hardcoded fixture in tests/test_claim_guards.py, so the guard could only restate a decision somebody had already made. Every field here carries a run, a notebook entry and a commit; a field whose provenance does not resolve is treated as ABSENT, so writing `true` into this file discharges nothing. The per-record sha256 is tamper-EVIDENCE, not tamper-proofing: it makes a changed value impossible to change SILENTLY, which is what review can catch.

E0_basis_transfer_K562.description: E0/E0b basis transfer: K562 Replogle perturbation-response subspace aligns with TCGA bulk RNA more than non-responsive perturbations do. Gap +0.0727 at k=10, ~10-11% of the split-half ceiling. INADMISSIBLE: single_platform stands.

proliferation_controlled.how: claim_guards remedy #2: responsive arm stratified by proliferation loading. The premise is real (responsive perturbations 3.01x enriched for proliferation targets, Fisher p=1.1e-13) but removing every one of them retains 91.4-98.3% of the gap and clears E0's own decision at 8/8 cells; a size-matched random placebo retains within 0.4-7.9 percentage points.
proliferation_controlled.scope: K562 only, both transforms, k in {10,25,50,100}. RPE1 UNDECIDABLE and not run. Stratified by TARGET GENE identity, which does not remove proliferation SIGNAL from the surviving perturbations' response profiles.

platforms.how: K562 and RPE1 are different LINEAGES on the SAME Perturb-seq CRISPRi protocol. Two lineages on one protocol is one platform, so this does NOT discharge single_platform.

morphology_to_pbs_axis_legibility.description: Morphology (wsi_biology) reads PBS molecular axes on TCGA held-out patients. INADMISSIBLE: composition_attribution and no_external_cohort both stand.

purity_in_adjustment_set.how: Real PanCanAtlas ABSOLUTE purity (DNA-derived, sha256 f430a975...) in confound_design. Channel retains 92.6-98.9% of excess over null in 6/6 artifact-seed cells; a rank-matched placebo moves it by at most +0.0018.
purity_in_adjustment_set.scope: TCGA test split, n=2650 complete-case, 90 non-control RNA targets, 16 components.
